6b248bdfe55d11c4ac3df7d533efa1ca.overview: Pat Brennan's luck is about to go from bad to worse; after gambling his horse away, he gets a ride from Willard and Doretta Mims. However, their stagecoach is hijacked by a trio of merciless bandits, led by ruthless Frank Usher. As Usher holds the passengers hostage, Brennan falls in love with Doretta and develops a risky plan to free himself and the Mimses, leading to a bloody final standoff.
6b248bdfe55d11c4ac3df7d533efa1ca.tagline: Taut! Torrid! Tremendous! T Is for Terror!

6b30cb4c31181e54419fd780021d44a1.overview: Ernesto Guevara, known as 'Che', leads a group of Cuban exiles under Fidel Castro in a revolution to overthrow Fulgencio Batista, the dictator of Cuba.
6b30cb4c31181e54419fd780021d44a1.tagline: Everyone knows the icon. Few know the man.

6b36168ee5d13c802a588237bb90b003.overview: A moll, imprisoned after participating in a bank robbery, helps with a breakout plot.

6b5f31c2f2a067cc88074025d2bd480c.overview: Julie, a daydreaming librarian, meets Céline, an enigmatic magician, and together they become the heroines of a time-warping adventure involving a haunted house, psychotropic candy, and a murder-mystery melodrama.

6b74e5fa4a3220f2b574dc1f535444eb.overview: Monty Python perform many of their greatest sketches at the Hollywood Bowl, including several from pre-Python days.
6b74e5fa4a3220f2b574dc1f535444eb.tagline: Never before in the history of human civilization has there been a movie called "Monty Python Live at the Hollywood Bowl"

6b766dc20982370ad33ebb3e812ab401.overview: Photographer Robert Kincaid wanders into the life of housewife Francesca Johnson for four days in the 1960s.
6b766dc20982370ad33ebb3e812ab401.tagline: A love like this happens to some of us sooner or later. For Robert and Francesca, it was later.

6b8afb337710e7d9e059ccc4058f8905.overview: On one random day in the San Fernando Valley, a dying father, a young wife, a male caretaker, a famous lost son, a police officer in love, a boy genius, an ex-boy genius, a game show host and an estranged daughter will each become part of a dazzling multiplicity of plots, but one story.
6b8afb337710e7d9e059ccc4058f8905.tagline: Things fall down. People look up. And when it rains, it pours.

6bab587472635ddae102eafc76c49c24.overview: Discover the game-changing partnership between a then undiscovered Michael Jordan and Nike's fledgling basketball division which revolutionized the world of sports and culture with the Air Jordan brand.
6bab587472635ddae102eafc76c49c24.tagline: Some icons are meant to fly.

6bdcd142669d55ece0fd6e4804b6aba8.overview: World War I brings tribulations to an American woman married to a German.

6bdeb707bdd78e7eae024fd1930ee2b8.overview: Young orphan Heathcliff is adopted by the wealthy Earnshaw family and moves into their estate, Wuthering Heights. Soon, the new resident falls for his compassionate foster sister, Cathy. The two share a remarkable bond that seems unbreakable until Cathy, feeling the pressure of social convention, suppresses her feelings and marries Edgar Linton, a man of means who befits her stature. Heathcliff vows to win her back.
6bdeb707bdd78e7eae024fd1930ee2b8.tagline: I am torn with Desire… tortured by hate!

6bf55e62234b4dc934dc47ed3298effd.overview: African-American documentary filmmaker Marlon Riggs was working on this final film as he died from AIDS-related complications in 1994; he addresses the camera from his hospital bed in several scenes. The film directly addresses sexism and homophobia within the black community, with snippets of misogynistic and anti-gay slurs from popular hip-hop songs juxtaposed with interviews with African-American intellectuals and political theorists, including Cornel West, bell hooks and Angela Davis.
6bf55e62234b4dc934dc47ed3298effd.tagline: A personal journey through Black identity

6bfdbb84c803c581d27e6819c920e1ea.overview: To gain entry to Heaven, a ghost attempts to reunite a divorcing couple as a good deed.
